decisions.rationale: X-linked Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy refers to one specific disease entity (the X-linked form linked to emerin), with a single definition and no further subdivision, so it is a Specific Disease with the whole phrase kept as the minimum necessary span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy is a named disease with one definition and is not a family of further-categorized diseases, so it is a Specific Disease. It is annotated separately from the abbreviation and from the later duplicate mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: EMD is the abbreviation defined as Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy in the text. The abbreviation is a separate synonymous mention that refers to the same specific disease.

X-linked EMD is a repeated mention of the specific X-linked form of Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease in its own right, even though it duplicates an earlier mention.
